name: codedroid
description: Drive your Android phone through CodeDroid, with MCP tools and device testing skills.

interface.shortDescription: Read, drive, and test on your real Android phone
interface.longDescription: Read the screen, tap and type, hand CodeDroid a whole task, run adb, and verify Android app changes on your real phone. Requires the CodeDroid app on the phone.
defaultPrompt: Read the screen on my phone and describe what is open.
Open Android Settings and check the Android version.
Install my app on the phone, open it, and check for crashes.
